opening.argument: The speaker turns a Polybius cryptocurrency into an investment solicitation, explaining how to register through the investment page and directing viewers who want to invest to the link in the description. He presents the token as a share of the company whose holders will receive a percentage of its revenues, while predicting that its price should grow 1.5–2 times after exchange issuance. The appeal is strengthened by a stated 25% bonus during the first two days. Although he acknowledges that buyers may be weak, that the token could be sold for less, and that the project was not yet launched, the material still promotes a return-oriented purchase with explicit instructions for participation.
